import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load data
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
NO2_PATH = "chunks_csv/getisord/getisord_no2_Q3_2021.csv"
ADJ_PATH = "chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv"

df_no2 = pd.read_csv(NO2_PATH)                       # borough, avg_no2_value
df_adj  = pd.read_csv(ADJ_PATH)                      # borough, neighbor

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Drop boroughs with missing NO2 values
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
missing_boroughs = set(df_no2.loc[df_no2["avg_no2_value"].isna(), "borough"])
valid_boroughs   = set(df_no2.loc[df_no2["avg_no2_value"].notna(), "borough"])

# fast look-up: borough -> NO2 value
no2_series = df_no2.set_index("borough")["avg_no2_value"].loc[valid_boroughs]

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Build cleaned, symmetric adjacency lists (excluding missing boroughs)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
adj_dict = {b: set() for b in valid_boroughs}

for _, row in df_adj.iterrows():
    b, n = row["borough"], row["neighbor"]
    if b in valid_boroughs and n in valid_boroughs:
        adj_dict[b].add(n)          # original direction
        adj_dict[n].add(b)          # make it symmetric

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Local‐area sums Lᵢ  (borough i plus all remaining neighbours)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
local_sums = {}
for b in valid_boroughs:
    local_set = {b}.union(adj_dict.get(b, set()))
    local_sums[b] = no2_series.loc[list(local_set)].sum()

L = pd.Series(local_sums)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Global mean μ and sample std σ of the local sums
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
mu     = L.mean()
sigma  = L.std(ddof=1)

# Guard against a (pathological) zero std
if sigma == 0:
    z_scores = pd.Series(np.zeros(len(L)), index=L.index)
else:
    z_scores = (L - mu) / sigma

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Identify statistically significant hot / cold spots
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
results = []
for b, z in z_scores.items():
    if abs(z) > 1.96:                     # 95 % two-tailed
        label = "HOT"  if z > 0 else "COLD"
        results.append(f"{b} ({label}, z={z:.3f})")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Output
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
data_points_used = len(valid_boroughs)
print(f"data_points_used = {data_points_used}")

if results:
    print(f"FINAL ANSWER: {', '.join(results)}")
else:
    print("FINAL ANSWER: none")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from collections import defaultdict

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load data
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
NO2_PATH = "chunks_csv/getisord/getisord_no2_Q3_2021.csv"
ADJ_PATH = "chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv"

no2_df = pd.read_csv(NO2_PATH)          # columns: borough, avg_no2_value
adj_df = pd.read_csv(ADJ_PATH)          # columns: borough, neighbor

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Build an UNDIRECTED adjacency dictionary
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
adjacency = defaultdict(set)
for _, row in adj_df.iterrows():
    b, n = row["borough"], row["neighbor"]
    adjacency[b].add(n)
    adjacency[n].add(b)                 # make the relationship symmetric

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Drop boroughs with missing NO2 values and clean the adjacency lists
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
no2_series = no2_df.set_index("borough")["avg_no2_value"]
missing_boroughs = set(no2_series[no2_series.isna()].index)

# keep only boroughs that have data
no2_series = no2_series.dropna()
retained_boroughs = set(no2_series.index)

# prune neighbor lists so they contain only retained boroughs
for b in list(adjacency.keys()):
    adjacency[b] = {n for n in adjacency[b] if n in retained_boroughs}
# make sure every retained borough has an entry in the dict
for b in retained_boroughs:
    adjacency.setdefault(b, set())

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Build local areas (borough + its surviving neighbors) and local sums
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
local_sums = {}
for b in retained_boroughs:
    local_area = {b} | adjacency[b]
    # pandas does not accept a set indexer, so convert to list
    local_sum = no2_series.loc[list(local_area)].sum()
    local_sums[b] = local_sum

local_sum_series = pd.Series(local_sums)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Global mean & std of Lᵢ, then z-scores
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
mu = local_sum_series.mean()
sigma = local_sum_series.std(ddof=1)

# guard against pathological σ=0 (extremely unlikely here)
if np.isclose(sigma, 0):
    z_scores = pd.Series(np.nan, index=local_sum_series.index)
else:
    z_scores = (local_sum_series - mu) / sigma

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Identify statistically significant HOT / COLD spots
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
results = []
for b, z in z_scores.items():
    if np.isnan(z):
        continue
    if abs(z) > 1.96:          # 95 % two-tailed
        label = "HOT" if z > 0 else "COLD"
        results.append(f"{b} ({label}, z={z:.3f})")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Output exactly as required
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
data_points_used = len(retained_boroughs)
print(f"data_points_used = {data_points_used}")

if results:
    print(f"FINAL ANSWER: {', '.join(results)}")
else:
    print("FINAL ANSWER: none")
